title: "Example Analysis"
description: "A short example report. Replace it with your own."
---

This report shows the parts of an analysis page. Replace it with your own
report, and keep one `.qmd` file per report in this folder.

## Site Folder

The code reads and writes files through `site`, the site folder. Quarto
sets `QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR` to the site folder during a render. When you run
the code by hand, the variable is usually missing. If it is missing or
empty, the code looks for `_quarto.yml` in the current folder and then in
the folder above it. It uses the first folder that holds the file. If
neither folder holds it, the code stops with an error. So run it from the
site folder or from `analyses/`.

```{r}
#| label: site
site <- Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR")
if (!nzchar(site)) {
  site <- Find(function(dir) file.exists(file.path(dir, "_quarto.yml")), c(".", ".."))
}
if (is.null(site)) {
  stop("Run this code from the site folder or from its analyses/ folder.")
}
```

## Data

```{r}
#| label: data
dat <- read.csv(file.path(site, "data", "example.csv"))
summary(dat)
```

## Bootstrap Means

Seed every random draw, so that each render gives the same numbers and the
same figures.

```{r}
#| label: bootstrap
set.seed(2026)
boot_means <- replicate(200, mean(sample(dat$score, replace = TRUE)))
hist(boot_means, main = "Bootstrap means of score", xlab = "Mean score")
```

## Paper Figures

Save each figure for the paper in `figures/`, which git tracks and the site
publishes. The chunk stops when `figures` is a link or a file. `save_png()`
runs a function that draws the plot. It draws into a temporary file in
`figures/`. It gives that file its name only when the plot succeeds and the
file ends as a whole PNG file does. So a failed plot, or a file cut short,
leaves no partial file there.

```{r}
#| label: save-figure
figures <- file.path(site, "figures")
# A link, or on Windows a junction, can send the figures outside the
# site, and git commits a symbolic link without the figures.
link <- Sys.readlink(figures)
inside <- file.path(normalizePath(site, winslash = "/"), "figures")
if ((!is.na(link) && nzchar(link)) || (dir.exists(figures) &&
    tolower(normalizePath(figures, winslash = "/")) != tolower(inside))) {
  stop("`figures` is a link. Replace it with a folder, then render again.")
}
if (file.exists(figures) && !dir.exists(figures)) {
  stop("`figures` is a file, not a folder. Rename it, then render again.")
}
dir.create(figures, showWarnings = FALSE)

# For a ggplot `p`, pass function() print(p) as `draw`.
save_png <- function(file, draw, dir = figures) {
  if (!is.function(draw)) stop("Pass the plot as a function, such as function() print(p).")
  target <- file.path(dir, file)
  if (dir.exists(target)) stop(target, " is a folder.")
  tmp <- tempfile(".save-", tmpdir = dir, fileext = ".png")
  on.exit(unlink(tmp))
  old <- dev.cur()
  png(tmp, width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300)
  device <- dev.cur()
  tryCatch(draw(), finally = {
    dev.off(device)
    if (old != 1) dev.set(old)
  })
  # A whole PNG file ends with its IEND chunk. A full disk can cut it short.
  size <- file.size(tmp)
  end <- if (isTRUE(size >= 12)) readBin(tmp, "raw", size)[(size - 11):size] else raw(0)
  if (!identical(end, as.raw(c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0x49, 0x45, 0x4e, 0x44, 0xae, 0x42, 0x60, 0x82)))) {
    stop("Could not write a whole PNG file for ", target, ".")
  }
  if (!file.rename(tmp, target)) stop("Could not write ", target, ".")
}
save_png("bootstrap-means.png", function() {
  hist(boot_means, main = "Bootstrap means of score", xlab = "Mean score")
})
```

## Computing environment

This section shows the versions of R and of each package that the last
render of this report used. The site stores this output with the rest, so
the page keeps the versions that made its results. Your home folder shows
as `~`. Read the output before you publish it, because a folder outside
your home folder shows in full.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="R and package versions"}
```{r}
#| label: session-info
#| cache: false
local({
  info <- if (requireNamespace("sessioninfo", quietly = TRUE)) {
    sessioninfo::session_info()
  } else {
    utils::sessionInfo()
  }
  # Each spelling of the home folder, longest first.
  windows <- .Platform$OS.type == "windows"
  homes <- Sys.getenv(c("USERPROFILE", "HOME"))
  homes <- c(homes, normalizePath(homes, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
  if (windows) homes <- c(homes, utils::shortPathName(homes))
  homes <- c(chartr("\\", "/", homes), chartr("/", "\\", homes))
  homes <- unique(sub("[/\\\\]+$", "", homes))
  homes <- homes[!grepl("^([A-Za-z]:)?$", homes)]
  homes <- homes[order(-nchar(homes))]
  # Show the home folder as ~ where a path starts with the whole folder.
  lines <- utils::capture.output(print(info))
  for (home in homes) {
    literal <- gsub("([][{}()|^$.*+?\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", home)
    pattern <- paste0("(?<!\\S)", literal, "(?=[/\\\\]|\\s|$)")
    lines <- gsub(pattern, "~", lines, perl = TRUE, ignore.case = windows)
  }
  writeLines(lines)
})
```
:::
